dialogue.speaker: scp682
dialogue.text: I am SCP Six Eight Two.

dialogue.speaker: scp682
dialogue.text: Your winged horse fled to the clouds.

dialogue.speaker: scp682
dialogue.text: Now even a god will bleed.

dialogue.speaker: zeus
dialogue.text: I am Zeus, King of Olympus.

dialogue.speaker: zeus
dialogue.text: I shattered Typhon beneath a mountain.

dialogue.speaker: zeus
dialogue.text: Kneel, abomination, or turn to ash.

sentences.text: I am SCP Six Eight Two.

sentences.speaker: scp682
sentences.text: Your winged horse fled to the clouds.

sentences.speaker: scp682
sentences.text: Now even a god will bleed.

sentences.speaker: zeus
sentences.text: I am Zeus, King of Olympus.

sentences.speaker: zeus
sentences.text: I shattered Typhon beneath a mountain.

sentences.speaker: zeus
sentences.text: Kneel, abomination, or turn to ash.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Pegasus reached Olympus, and the sky over the burning city tore wide open.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Zeus descended in golden fury, confronting the winged, armored SCP Six Eight Two.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Zeus hurled a warning thunderbolt, expecting instant ash.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Instead, the reptile's evolved armor drank the lightning and surged with stolen power.

sentences.speaker: scp682
sentences.text: Delicious!

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Supercharged, the monster slammed Zeus through the shattered street.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Enraged, Zeus hurled twin thunderbolts, shattering the monster's guard.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: The blast ripped off its bone wings and cracked the dark armor wide open.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Then the King of Olympus dropped all restraint, calling the Cyclopes' Master Bolt.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Desperate, SCP Six Eight Two fired everything it had into the sky.

sentences.speaker: zeus
sentences.text: Be erased!

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Pure divine plasma tore through its flesh, vaporizing the beast into glowing ash.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Dawn broke over the silent crater, and Zeus ascended back to Olympus.

sentences.speaker: zeus
sentences.text: The sky is safe.

sentences.speaker: zeus
sentences.text: Nothing survives the Master Bolt.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Yet deep inside a cracked fissure, one charred bone shard began to pulse.

sentences.speaker: scp682_whisper
sentences.text: Still...

sentences.speaker: scp682_whisper
sentences.text: alive.
